description: Update organization player/theme fields (name, player_color, player_subtitle, cover/theme override flags, default_collection_id). organization_id is optional and derived from the API key when omitted. Pass default_collection_id to set which collection is used when create-track omits collection_id. Requires AudioDN OAuth sign-in (call adn_sign_in or complete account login first).
name: adn_update_organization
